patch_description: This design replaces broad neighborhood enumeration and archive relinking with a bounded, adaptive shake search. It still uses repaired QAOA samples for diverse starting points and LP dual prices to identify bottleneck links, but generates only a small set of randomized degree-preserving mutations per round. Surrogate energy cheaply screens those mutations before LP evaluation. A temperature-based acceptance rule lets the current walk cross local barriers, while a separate best-so-far record and a compact quality/diversity archive preserve strong solutions and enable restarts. Mutation size grows after stalls, shifting effort toward larger perturbations without repeatedly constructing huge neighborhoods.
